headline: Profitability climbs sharply year over year
summary_short: Tripod Technology posted Q2 FY2026 EPS of TWD 7.40, up 59.1% y/y from TWD 4.65.
summary_long: EPS of TWD7.40 rose 59.1% year-over-year from TWD4.65 and 31.9% sequentially from TWD5.61 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
